validation_checks: Data quality: verify no missing concentration-time pairs, covariate completeness, and endpoint classification consistency
PK model selection: compare 1- and 2-compartment fits using OFV, AIC, and visual predictive checks; confirm parameter identifiability
Covariate screening: test weight_kg, creatinine_clearance_ml_min, and genotype individually on PK parameters; document effect sizes and statistical significance
Exposure-response relationship: confirm AUC derivation from selected PK model and assess linearity of clinical_response and grade2plus_adverse_event against AUC
Predictive performance: generate posterior predictive checks for PK concentrations and compare observed vs. model-predicted efficacy and safety rates by AUC quartile
Uncertainty quantification: report parameter estimates with 95% confidence intervals and sensitivity analysis for key covariate effects
Population heterogeneity: assess residual variability and inter-individual PK variability after covariate adjustment
dosing_policy: Conservative dosing recommendations require both exposure-matched simulation and statistically significant covariate effects from the final PK/PD model. A material covariate identified during screening but lacking exposure-matched simulation or conflicting with efficacy-safety balance will be classified as insufficient evidence; no dose adjustment will be proposed for such covariates. Dosing guidance is limited to the observed dose level (100 mg IV bolus) and target AUC ranges derived from the validated exposure-response analysis.
